modes.cue_notes: Open the hips and shoulders to the long edge of the mat, front knee tracking over the ankle, arms reaching actively in opposite directions at shoulder height. Gaze softly over the front fingertips.

breathing_cues.entering: Inhale to spread the arms wide as the hips and torso open toward the side of the mat.
breathing_cues.holding: Breathe steadily; inhale to lift through the crown, exhale to root down through both feet and sink the front thigh toward parallel.
breathing_cues.exiting: Exhale to straighten the front leg and turn the feet to face the next direction.

prop_free_variation: Shorten the stance and reduce front-knee bend for tighter hips or knee sensitivity.
